title: Virginia Switzer:
title_short: Virginia Switzer · AYH · Just a Pair of Shoes
headline: The co-chair of Soles4Souls Twin Cities says her life is filled to overflowing, and that cool new shoes tell a kid someone cares.
story: Virginia co-chairs the Soles4Souls Twin Cities initiative. This was their second annual shoe distribution at Mall of America: 500 of the 10,000 homeless kids in the Twin Cities got new shoes.
Asked if she is happy, she says she is beyond happy. She is called to serve, and any time she can give of her gifts, she is one happy camper.
Cool new shoes signal that someone cares. When a kid's confidence changes, they go to school and play sports. Just a pair of shoes, but it can change the world.
do: Open on the 500-of-10,000 line with the hook text on screen.
Name super at 00:03: Virginia Switzer / Co-Chair, Soles4Souls Twin Cities.
Keep her energy. Close pauses to about 0.3 s, except the one before “to overflowing” (0.6 s).
End on “it can change the world.”
dont: No logo, title card or fade at 0:00.
No stock footage. This shoot has no B-roll.
No “It's God” answer (030_3160 00:33 to 00:58). The brief leaves it out.
Don't use the mic bump (030_3160 00:30) or “I just hit the mic”.
